instruction: A low-angle medium-full action photograph captures an outdoor concrete lot under a bright sky. On the left, the man in the beige striped shirt (R2) crouches low on his left roller skate, extending his right leg forward while raising his free hand with fingers spread. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt (R1) crouches on his right yellow skate, leaning backward. The man in the beige striped shirt and the man in the white t-shirt hold hands high between them to stay balanced. Warm, direct daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the pavement.
